old: A 2015 1 dollar from Jamaica. The obverse shows the coat of arms with a crocodile crest and Taino supporters, with JAMAICA, OUT OF MANY, ONE PEOPLE, ONE DOLLAR, and 2015. The reverse shows a facing bust of Sir Alexander Bustamante with THE RT. EXCELLENT SIR ALEXANDER BUSTAMANTE and NATIONAL HERO. The coin is round and struck in nickel-clad steel.
